name: The Shooting Star Addition: SA Series
description: An unofficial addon for The Shooting Star (Demo). Adds four skills to the Stellar Remote: SA-01 Halley, a comet that ploughs a frozen trench and detonates on your crosshair; SA-02 Luna, the Moon itself falling onto your mark; SA-04 Proxima, a solar flare fired from a red dwarf 4.2 light years away; and SA-00 Stellar Convergence, every weapon at once. Power, damage and speed sliders like the original's skills. Needs The Shooting Star (Demo) 1.5.2 and RimuLib.
